features.contract: the x19 committee learners: 276 timeline bundle features + 27 ADS-B departure/neighbour features + 11 v19 features (314)

hardware: one AWS L40S via SkyPilot (infra/aws/sky_ctx2.yaml); tools/run_adsb_ctx2.py --device cuda, float32 with TF32 matrix products; every round-2 run of this declaration on that hardware
prior_evidence: Round 1 (configs/adsb_ctx_design_v1.json, docs/adsb_ctx/design_report_1.json): 6 CPU seeds 155.40 s standalone (non-LIRF October), recipe proxy -1.19% over the 32-seed pool at b = 1, still rising with seeds. Its CPU development round (configs/adsb_ctx_v1.json) runs unchanged on Azure; round-2 networks are never mixed into it.

protocol.data: tools/run_adsb_ctx2.py --fold design: the round-1 design fold exactly (seasonal fit partition 2025-02..06, 08, 09 without LIRF; October monitored; October predictions only)
protocol.decision: A variant replaces the round-1 settings for a GPU development round if its seed mean beats g_ctx's seed mean at equal seed count by at least 0.10 percentage points of recipe proxy at b = 1.0 AND is better standalone (R1). If several qualify, the lowest R2 at b = 1.0; if none, the round-1 settings stand. Either way the next development round (if any) is declared separately, after the CPU round's selection is known.
protocol.never_read: No round-2 design run predicts, scores or reads a label of 2025-01, 2025-07, 2025-11, 2025-12 or the ranking months.

readings.R1: October non-LIRF RMSE per run and per variant seed mean, against g_ctx at equal seed counts; g_ctx against the round-1 CPU seeds at equal counts (hardware check, descriptive)
readings.R2: incremental over the incumbent pool exactly as round 1 (tools/ctx_design_report.py): table = 0.5 committee + 0.5 [(1 - b) nnb32 + b variant_mean], recipe proxy for b in {0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0}

purpose: Second design round of the context network on the AWS L40S (infra/aws/gpu_authorization_20260925.json): does a wider neighbour window, self-attention among neighbours, a wider token encoder or a longer budget beat the round-1 settings? October only, BEFORE any development score of a round-2 network.
smoke: a code-path smoke on the GPU worker (--limit-rows, one epoch, an undeclared scratch config) precedes the runs and is not a reading

tokens.data/ctx/tokens_v1: round-1 build (K 128, [-60, +30] min, centre -15 min), rebuilt on the worker by tools/build_ctx_tokens.py; content hashes must equal the local manifest
tokens.data/ctx/tokens_w256: tools/build_ctx2_tokens.py --k 256 --before-min 120 --after-min 60 --centre-min -15 (same token contract, wider window); content hashes must equal the local build
